script_text:
Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now.

Venus, your ruling planet of Earth, is forming a square to Mercury in your 10th House of Career, putting your ambitions under a microscope. Meanwhile, the Full Moon in Gemini sextiles your 4th House of Home, stirring feelings about security.

In love, if you're single, this sextile makes you magnetically attractive to a loyal partner who mirrors your hidden desire for stability. If partnered, watch for jealousy over time and money; the square to Mercury wants honest words before old resentments erupt.

Career and money demand you avoid impulsive spending. That square to your 10th House says slow down before a big move. Unexpectedly, a small financial gift arrives from an unexpected source, easing your foundation.

Honor that warning, and receive the blessing. Breathe deeply. Trust. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
